description: Source code for MIME type utility functions in Chromium project, including MIME type mappings, parsing, and boundary generation.

classes.name: MimeUtil
classes.description: Singleton utility class for MIME type operations, including mapping, parsing, and validation.

methods.name: GetMimeTypeFromExtension
methods.description: Returns MIME type for a given file extension.

methods.name: GetMimeTypeFromFile
methods.description: Returns MIME type for a given file path.

methods.name: GetWellKnownMimeTypeFromExtension
methods.description: Returns well-known MIME type for a given extension.

methods.name: GetPreferredExtensionForMimeType
methods.description: Returns preferred file extension for a given MIME type.

methods.name: MatchesMimeType
methods.description: Checks if a MIME type matches a pattern, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: ParseMimeTypeWithoutParameter
methods.description: Parses MIME type string into top-level type and subtype.

methods.name: IsValidTopLevelMimeType
methods.description: Validates if a MIME type's top-level type is recognized.

methods.name: GetExtensionsForMimeType
methods.description: Retrieves file extensions associated with a MIME type.

methods.name: GenerateMimeMultipartBoundary
methods.description: Generates a unique boundary string for MIME multipart messages.

methods.name: AddMultipartValueForUpload
methods.description: Appends a multipart form-data segment with a value.

methods.name: AddMultipartValueForUploadWithFileName
methods.description: Appends a multipart form-data segment with a filename.

methods.name: AddMultipartFinalDelimiterForUpload
methods.description: Appends the final boundary delimiter for multipart data.

methods.name: ExtractMimeTypeFromMediaType
methods.description: Extracts MIME type from media type string, optionally handling comma-separated types.
